gloss: I, the longer pronoun. Strong gives H589 as its contraction, so the inventory counts both as one lexeme.
you, masculine singular, per OSHB Pp2ms. Strong's older English thou is rendered you.
he matches; that is in Strong's range. OSHB keeps the feminine under one lemma, so an inflection. Counted with H1992 as one third-person unit.
they matches; those is Strong's demonstrative use. Longer spelling shares lemma 1992. Strong: masculine plural from 1931, so one third-person unit with H1931.
this, masculine, per OSHB Pdxms. Strong's own number for the feminine isn't lexeme proof: one suppletive paradigm, linked by derivation because the enum has no paradigm value.
this, feminine, per OSHB Pdxfs. Strong calls it the irregular feminine of H2088: one paradigm, linked by derivation because the enum has no paradigm value.
these, per OSHB Pdxcp. Suppletive plural of the same paradigm as זֶה, despite its own Strong number.
Object marker follows OSHB To. Strong's own note gives entity, and says it is used to point out the object; no English word is taught.
that, because, when are in Strong's range. Conjunction per OSHB HC.
face, surface, presence are Strong's range. Plural in form per OSHB Ncbp.
name matches; reputation is in Strong's definition.
covenant is in Strong's usage; binding agreement renders compact.
with and beside render Strong's nearness sense. Homograph of H853, recorded on both cards.
with and together with match. Doubled mem before the suffix is the form in Gen.3.6.
there is and there are render the particle; OSHB tags Tm.
there is not and nothing fit the negative entity sense. Shorter form shares lemma 369.
who, which, that are Strong's defs. Relative per OSHB Tr.
find and obtain are Strong's senses.
call, name and read are Strong's range.
create matches. OSHB lemma 1254 a.
sister matches.
lord and master are Strong's range. Gen.23.6 013uB replaces Gen.18.3, whose addressee is ambiguous. The Hittites speak to Abraham, read in XML.
living being renders the breathing creature; life and self are Strong's extensions. The card flags soul as a poor default.
mouth and opening are in Strong's range; a dove's beak in Gen.8.11 is contextual.
also and even match. OSHB Ta.
look renders lo; here I am is the suffixed form in context.
again, still and more are in Strong's range.
so and thus match. OSHB lemma 3651 c.
keep, guard and watch over are Strong's range. OSHB q is a sequential perfect, which the card's and they will keep reflects.
be, become and happen are Strong's range. The card warns that the jussive isn't a past.
stressNote: Strong's pron haw-yaw carries no stress mark, so there is nothing to compare. Final stress follows the verb's accented 3ms perfects such as הָיָ֣ה and the card's Qal perfect pattern.

gloss: be able and can match. Strong's headword spells it with holam.
pursue and chase match.
grow up and become great follow Strong's twisting-to-large sense.
be full and fill are Strong's range. Fill is both Qal (Gen.1.22 01RCg Vqv2mp) and Piel (Gen.21.19 01jXc).
fear and revere are Strong's range.
if and whether match. OSHB lemma 518 a.
what, how and why are Strong's range.
who matches.
do not and let not render the negative of a wish, as Strong's subjective negative. OSHB Tn.
please and now render the entreaty particle.
there matches.
very and greatly render Strong's vehemence sense. OSHB D.
one matches; a certain is Strong's indefinite use.
two matches. OSHB tags dual.
three matches. OSHB's gender tag is the form's gender, which the card states as used with feminine nouns.
five matches; same tagging note as three.
seven matches; the -ah form is tagged masculine, as the card states.
ten matches. The -teen word is H6240, which Strong derives from H6235: a combining form, linked by derivation and never counted as a lexeme.
hundred matches; construct per OSHB.
